notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only site-specific source is the Alberta register extract, which is the same query URL used for ca-ab-athabasca and ca-ab-baldy. No news, archive or trail-guide source for Aurora was found in the searches run. OpenStreetMap way 1557410030 tags a 30 m tower (height=30) and was not quoted because its tags span several lines. Brief's access 'closed' is not stated by any source; recorded as restricted. The open.alberta.ca and Lonely Lookouts evidence is general Alberta context, not a claim about this site. The story's 'summit' and 'tower' types are context only, not a claim that Aurora is one or the other beyond its steel-tower register type. Mapcarta (not used) places the site near Aurora Natural Area. Fact-check 2026-10-20: removed 'helps staff' (staff not in the source), replaced 'above the trees' with the source's 'obstacles to vision', and restored the 'After 1912' qualifier from the Alberta Historic Places source.
